summary: I'm Lead Coach at Usawa Health Coaching, and I teach its interactive online class every Tuesday at 7pm East Africa Time for busy people who are tired all the time. We look at what's draining you and work on one small change at a time, the kind you can keep with a full job and a full house.
audience: People who keep up at work and at home and are running on empty. Working parents doing everything for everyone, people whose doctor told them to reduce stress, and students and young professionals with big goals and short nights. Young people juggling their own goals are welcome to ask too. Anyone 17 or younger has a parent or guardian on the free call.
problem:
Before: "I'm fine, just tired. Work is crazy." "I can't switch off at night." "I'll sort myself out after this project." Lunch at the desk, short nights, and the rest they promised themselves keeps moving to next month.
After: they understand how stress and everyday choices affect their energy, and they have small habits that fit a real week.
moments:
Their doctor told them to reduce stress and they weren't sure how
They hold it together at work, then start again at home
They can't switch off at night
They're running on tea and late nights between study, work and big plans
The rest they promised themselves keeps moving to next month
offerings:
The weekly Usawa Health Coaching class with me, interactive and online
Practical ways to manage stress that fit the life you already have
Small everyday habits, not a diet and not a strict plan
Work on energy and resilience for long days
The Explorer Leadership Clubs for high school students, which I also coordinate (Friday mornings, online and in person)
howItRuns:
One class a week, every Tuesday at 7pm East Africa Time, online. How long each class runs and how many weeks the program lasts, people can ask on the free call. If they live in another time zone, they should mention it then.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team, any time in the next three weeks. A parent or guardian joins for anyone 17 or younger. After the call, if it fits, they join the class on a Tuesday evening.
faqs:
Q: Is this medical? I already see a doctor.
A: No. It's coaching, not treatment. Keep seeing your doctor. The class is about the everyday habits around your health, like how you handle stress.

Q: When and where is the class?
A: Every Tuesday at 7pm East Africa Time, online. Ask on your free call how long each class runs and how many weeks it lasts, and mention it if you're in another time zone.

Q: I don't have time.
A: I know. It's one class a week, and right now it's just a free 15-minute call.

Q: I've tried apps and diets.
A: This isn't a diet. You look at why you're tired and work on small habits you can keep.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: You'll get the exact price on your free call.
aboutYou:
I'm Lead Coach at Usawa Health Coaching. My background is in pharmacy and international public health.

My work is helping people understand how stress, lifestyle and everyday choices shape their health and their performance. In class I take the health science and turn it into things you can actually do on a Tuesday when you're exhausted.

I also coordinate the Explorer Leadership Clubs for high school students.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
No medical advice, diagnoses or treatment claims. It's coaching, and people should keep seeing their doctor.
Never promise a cure, weight loss or a set result.
Don't call it a diet or a strict plan.
